name: CBC / Biogard
notes: Division of CBC (Europe); distributes Shin-Etsu Isomate/Isonet mating-disruption dispensers across the EU. Track new Isomate/Isonet products and registrations.

name: Shin-Etsu
notes: Japanese manufacturer of the Isomate/Isonet pheromone dispensers. Track new semiochemical formulations and dispenser technologies.

name: Andermatt Biocontrol
notes: Swiss biocontrol company; pheromone lures, traps and mating disruption (e.g. Mister C for codling moth).

name: M2i Biocontrol
notes: French pheromone-based biocontrol manufacturer (e.g. Cydia Pro Press). Distribution partnership with Bayer — watch for joint launches.

name: SEDQ
notes: Spanish semiochemicals company (Cryptotec, Flypack Dacus Trap, Praystec). Track mating disruption and Attract & Kill products.

name: Semios
notes: Canadian precision-ag company; automated pheromone dispensers and trap networks (e.g. Semios CRS Eco). Track active-dispenser products and EPA registrations.

name: Bayer
notes: Distributes pheromone biocontrol (Vynyty Citrus, M2i products) alongside conventional insecticides (Decis, Movento). Track biocontrol partnerships and Attract & Kill products.

name: Lithos Crop Protect
notes: Austrian company; sprayable pheromone (pherolit-d / NERMADY) for Diabrotica in corn. Distribution agreement with Syngenta — track EU registrations.

name: Syngenta Biologicals
notes: Distributes Lithos Crop Protect's sprayable Diabrotica pheromone in Europe. Track biocontrol/pheromone launches and partnerships.
